hero.titleStart: Prepare for the NMT in maths —
hero.lead: An online workspace that shows your weak topics, trains you in exam format and gives a clear plan for the next steps. No scattered PDFs, no random tests.
hero.note: Sign up in a minute — no card, no payment
hero.imageAlt: Illustration: a function graph, a progress ring and geometric shapes

format.label: official exam format in the simulator

features.title: Everything you need for regular practice in one place
features.lead: From your first topic test to a full exam simulation.

topics.title: Topic tests
topics.text: Pick a topic and the number of tasks, then start right away. Every question comes with an explanation.

ultimate.title: Ultimate mode
ultimate.text: The same material, but against the clock. It teaches the pace you need on the real exam.

results.title: Results and analytics
results.text: Attempt history, share of correct answers and the trend for every topic separately.

recommendations.title: Personal recommendations
recommendations.text: After each test the system suggests what to revise and where to start the next session.

simulator.title: NMT simulator
simulator.text: A full paper in the official format with a timer and scoring — a rehearsal of the real exam.

sessions.title: Learning sessions
sessions.text: Planned practice and mentor sessions assigned by a teacher for your specific gaps.

steps.title: Four steps to a confident result
steps.lead: Nothing to configure — you can start right after signing up.

signup.title: Create an account
signup.text: Login, name and password. Takes under a minute.

diagnose.title: Take the diagnostic
diagnose.text: The first test shows your level and weak topics.

train.title: Practise with a plan
train.text: Topics, Ultimate or the simulator — depending on your goal.

track.title: Track your progress
track.text: The dashboard shows the trend and the next steps.

faq.title: The short answers
faq.lead: What people ask most often before signing up.

price.a: The student workspace is free: sign-up, topic tests, results and recommendations are available as soon as you create an account.

who.a: Students in years 10–11, past graduates and adults returning to maths. You choose the pace and the workload.

mobile.q: Can I study on a phone?
mobile.a: Yes. The interface is mobile-first: tests, the simulator and statistics work equally well on a phone, tablet and desktop.

recommendations.a: The system looks at your answers per topic and suggests revising the ones with the lowest share of correct answers before moving on.

teacher.q: Can I work with a teacher?
teacher.a: Yes. A teacher sees your results and can assign mentor sessions — separate practice for specific gaps.

cta.title: Start with your first topic today
cta.lead: Create a student account in a minute and take the first test to see your real level.

footer.tagline: Online NMT maths preparation: topic tests, result analytics, an exam simulator and learning sessions with a teacher.
